R35 — gen7 database audio ids vs the speech graffiti tag tables (read-only): for every `*audioid*` / `surnameid` column of every table
of the PS3 anchors 09–Legacy (repo `anchors/ps3/<title>/databases/nhlng.db` + metadata; PS3 = Xbox 360 for the speech data per handoff 04),
the set of non-zero values is compared with the key set of every tag type of `pbp_eng_graffitidata` (handoff 04 §2 layout, tag = EVT0
parameter id) and of the KWD0 keyword ids (15 / Legacy). Reports, per column: the best-matching tag type (largest containment), the
containment ratio, the values outside it (first 40), and the same for the ann (rink announcer) graffiti where it exists.
Usage: python r35_gen7_audio_id_bindings.py <out.json>
